prompts.01_classification: A crowd of people is divided by a wall, with one side wearing contrasting uniforms and the other in simpler attire, highlighting the us vs. them dynamic through clothing and cultural markers. The scene is a wide shot with balanced framing, set in a public square under soft natural light, emphasizing the division through bold linework and subtle shading.
prompts.02_symbolization: A street corner features a star-shaped emblem, marking the group with a distinct symbol. The composition is a close-up with centered framing, capturing the interplay of light and shadow on the emblem, with intricate hatching and cross-hatching to define the texture of the sign and surrounding walls.
prompts.03_discrimination: A courtroom scene shows a divided audience, with a sign on the wall separating groups through legal exclusion. The image is a medium shot with slightly off-center framing, lit by warm, diffused light that casts soft shadows, with detailed linework to emphasize the sign and the expressions of the people.
prompts.04_dehumanization: A group of people is depicted with exaggerated features, resembling animals, to convey their dehumanization. The close-up composition highlights facial details through sharp linework and stippling, with backlighting creating a contrast between the figures and the background, reinforcing the surreal, imaginative quality of the illustration.

The medium shot uses balanced framing, with natural light from the right casting soft shadows, and detailed shading to differentiate the crowd’s expressions and the text’s texture.
prompts.07_preparation: A line of people with numbered tags marks the preparation for mass killing. The wide shot has a slightly low-angle framing, with bright, directional light emphasizing the tags, using sharp linework to define the figures’ outlines.
prompts.08_persecution: A crowded ghetto with tents and a group marching through dust depict the systematic abuse of the targeted group. The panoramic framing captures the scene under golden-hour light, with textured brushstrokes and hatching to render the tents, dust, and the marchers’ silhouettes, blending surreal and imaginative elements.
prompts.09_extermination: A field of crosses and a wall with carvings illustrate the mass killing of the targeted group. The wide shot uses horizontal framing, with soft, diffused light from the left highlighting the crosses and stone, with intricate linework and shading to define the field’s depth and the carvings’ details.
prompts.10_denial: A blank wall where a monument once stood and a document with smudged ink show evidence of genocide being erased. The close-up composition centers on the wall, with backlighting emphasizing its texture, and detailed linework to capture the absence of the monument and the faint traces of the smudged text, creating a monochrome, imaginative scene.
